sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ashwani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Shiv Shanker Prasad,J.
This writ petition has been filed with the prayer to quash First Information Report registered as Case Crime No.185 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 313, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Khair, District Aligarh.
When the matter is taken up learned A.G.A. informs that in the matter investigation has already concluded with submission of closure report.
In view of the above statement no grievance survives for the petitioners to prosecute the writ petition any further.
Writ petition is accordingly consigned to records.
